'''Timothy Trevor West''' (8 May 1938 – 30 October 2012)<ref name=IT_11032012>{{cite news|url=http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/obituaries/2012/1103/1224326091379.html|title=Vigorous scholar, sportsman and senator|newspaper=[[The Irish Times]]|date=3 November 2012}}</ref> was an [[Irish people|Irish]] mathematician, academic and politician.<ref name=oireachtas_db>{{cite web|url=https://www.oireachtas.ie/en/members/member/Timothy-Trevor-West.S.1970-11-19/|title=Timothy Trevor West|work=Oireachtas Members Database|access-date=16 December 2011}}</ref>

==Biography==
He was born on 8 May 1938 in [[County Cork]], the eldest of four sons of Timothy Roberts West, headmaster of [[Midleton College]], and Dorothy West (née McNeill).<ref name=dib>{{cite web|url=https://www.dib.ie/biography/west-trevor-a10056|title=West, Trevor|work=[[Dictionary of Irish Biography]]|last=Timoney|first=Richard M.|access-date=18 February 2023}}</ref>

He was educated at Midleton College,<ref name="tcd-obit">{{cite web|url=http://www.ducac.tcdlife.ie/assets/pdf/2012-13/DUCAC%20General/In%20Memoriam-Timothy%20Trevor%20West%20-%20November%202012.pdf|title=In Memoriam – Timothy Trevor West|publisher=Dublin University Central Athletic Club|access-date=28 October 2013}}</ref> and [[The High School, Dublin]]. West was a graduate of [[Trinity College Dublin]] (TCD), where he was [[List of Scholars of Trinity College Dublin|elected a scholar]], and of the [[University of Cambridge]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/ireland/2012/1102/1224326035115.html|title=Funeral tomorrow of former TCD academic and senator|newspaper=[[The Irish Times]]|date=2 November 2012}}</ref> In 1970 he was elected a Fellow of Trinity College Dublin and was also an associate professor of mathematics, Junior Dean, and a great supporter of sport at Trinity.<ref name=bold_collegians>{{cite web|url=http://www.lilliputpress.ie/book/163/west_trevor-the_bold_collegians_the_development_of_sport_in_trinity_college_dublin.html|title=The Bold Collegians|work=The Lilliput Press|access-date=16 December 2011|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120310131426/http://www.lilliputpress.ie/book/163/west_trevor-the_bold_collegians_the_development_of_sport_in_trinity_college_dublin.html|archive-date=10 March 2012}}</ref> He was also a Member of the [[Royal Irish Academy]].<ref name="tcd-obit"/> He subsequently was a Senior Fellow of TCD.<ref>{{cite book |date=2000 |title=The University of Dublin Calendar 2000-01}}</ref>

On 19 November 1970, West was elected to [[Seanad Éireann]], at a [[by-election]] for the [[Dublin University (constituency)|Dublin University]] constituency caused by the death of [[Owen Sheehy-Skeffington]].<ref name=oireachtas_db/> After his election, he established a reputation as one of the few liberal voices in the Seanad.<ref name=IT_11032012/> He was re-elected to the Seanad in 1973 and 1977, lost his seat at the 1981 Seanad election but was re-elected in 1982, then lost his seat again at the 1983 Seanad election.<ref name=oireachtas_db/>

With [[John T. Lewis]] and D. McQuillan, West drew up the constitution of the [[Irish Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Societies/Irish.html The MacTutor History of Mathematics archive page on The Irish Mathematical Society]</ref>

He was the author of ''The Bold Collegians'', a history of sport in Trinity College,<ref name=bold_collegians/> and was an avid follower of Trinity College's sports programs. He also wrote a history of Midleton College, published for its [[tercentenary]] in 1996.<ref>Trevor West, ''Midleton College, 1696–1996: A Tercentenary History'' (Midleton, County Cork: Midleton College, 1996)</ref>

==Memorials==
An event was held in his memory at the [[Royal Irish Academy]] in December 2013 where a memorial issue of the Mathematical Proceedings of the Royal Irish Academy was presented.<ref>[https://www.ria.ie/events/events-listing/trevor-west--an-irish-mathematician.aspx Trevor West: An Irish Mathematician] {{webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20131213204200/https://www.ria.ie/events/events-listing/trevor-west--an-irish-mathematician.aspx |date=2013-12-13 }}</ref>

A book of essays celebrating his life, ''Trevor West : The Bold Collegian'', was published in October 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lilliputpress.ie/event/book-launch-trevor-west-bold-collegian|title=Trevor West : The Bold Collegian |access-date=30 October 2016}}</ref>

On 14 September 2018, a new sports hall in Midleton College dedicated to the memory of Trevor West was opened by the Provost of Trinity College, [[Patrick Prendergast (academic)|Patrick Prendergast]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://churchofirelandcork.com/?s=trevor+west|title=Speech by Bishop Paul Colton on the occasion of the official opening of the Trevor West sports hall|work=churchofirelandcork.com|date=16 September 2018}}</ref>

==Publications==
*Trevor West, with [[Rien Kaashoek]], ''Locally compact semi-algebras : with applications to spectral theory of positive operators'' (Amsterdam; London: North-Holland Publishing Co., 1974)
*Trevor West, ''The Bold Collegians. The Development of Sport in Trinity College Dublin'' (Dublin, 1991)
*Trevor West, ''Midleton College, 1696–1996: A Tercentenary History'' (Midleton: Midleton College, 1996)
